fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The footer navigation (the `<footer>` at the bottom of every page) did not visually indicate which section or subsection the user is currently viewing. The side-nav (`menu.mustache`) already applied a `current` CSS class to both top-level and submenu items using `{{#current}}current{{/current}}`, but `footer.mustache` did not use the `current` flag at all — even though `MenuItem.current` is already computed and available in the template context.

## What changed

- **`decksite/templates/footer.mustache`**: Added `{{#current}}current {{/current}}` to the top-level section anchor (`<a class="menuitem …">`) and converted the submenu anchor from a conditional `class` attribute to one that always renders with `{{#current}}current {{/current}}{{#is_external}}external{{/is_external}}`, matching the pattern used in `menu.mustache`.
- **`shared_web/static/css/pd.css`**: Added `footer a.current { font-weight: bold; }` so the current item is visibly distinguished in the footer.

No logic changes were needed — `MenuItem.current` is already set correctly by `shared_web/menu.py`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit shared_web` — 848 passed, 1 skipped

Fixes #6776
